release_notes: `app.py`: `/strategies/<name>/trade_ticks_stream`, a Server-Sent Events route reading `broker/tick_cache.py` directly to push true per-tick price updates into the open Trade Status modal (cache-only reads, never falls back to REST); the existing 5s poll still owns status/schedule/candle refresh and prices unchanged when the WS tick cache isn't running. `templates/base.html`: the Trade Status modal's auto-refresh/tick-listener registration ran before `#tradeStatusModal`'s markup was parsed into the DOM, so `getElementById()` returned `null` and the `.addEventListener()` call threw — silently killing the rest of the page's main script block since the listener was added on 2026-06-22. Now registered inside `DOMContentLoaded`. `app.py` `trade_ticks_stream`: queried `tick_cache` with the clean symbol instead of the `NFO:`-prefixed key the cache is actually keyed by — a guaranteed miss on every read. `scheduler.py`: `restart_if_dead()` now also detects a hung (not crashed) background thread via `_is_stuck()` (any job >15min past its `next_run_time`), not just `is_alive()` — root cause of a 2026-09-04 incident where an 18h thread hang missed a strategy's scheduled entry. Also adds `PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000` to the jobs.sqlite engine. `performance.py`: `_conn()` is now a proper `@contextmanager` that closes the connection on exit — every call site was leaking a connection (`with conn:` only commits/rolls back), which could collide with shutdown's re-encrypt step and raise `WinError 32` on `performance.db`. `templates/base.html`: Trade Status modal auto-refresh tightened from 30s to 5s, now that `ltp()`/`live_candles()` read the WS tick cache instead of REST.
